name: Weather Prime
description: A beautifully crafted weather companion that lives in your top bar. Glance up for current conditions, then dive into rich hourly and 7-day forecasts, real-time air quality from AirNow (US) or Open-Meteo (worldwide), live NWS severe weather alerts, and a smart pressure trend indicator that hints at incoming weather. Auto-detects your location via GeoClue2 or set it manually, refreshes on your schedule, and adapts to light or dark themes automatically. Works out of the box — no API keys, no signup, no fees. Optional WeatherAPI.com and AirNow keys unlock additional data sources for power users.
